registered_tools.name: sift_retrieve
registered_tools.label: Sift Retrieve
registered_tools.description: Retrieve the full original tool output from the local sift stash. Call this when compressed tool output contains <<stash:KEY>> and you need the original text.

storage_paths.redirection_mechanism: Set environment variable PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/home/khoa/pi-context-lab/.pi-agent. Isolation enforced: directory must not reside inside worktree (assertOutsideWorktree).

network_activity.details: Completely local execution. No outbound HTTP/API calls or telemetry detected.

@agent-context/pi-sift.rationale: Unbundled external dependency '@agent-context/sift' (0.0.1) is missing from the unpacked package and must be installed via npm. Once installed, native prebuilds exist for linux-x64. Entry point is raw TypeScript (index.ts) relying on Pi's TS/esm loader. In addition, SessionSiftStore enforces that the stash directory must be outside the active worktree.

registered_tools.name: context_tree_query
registered_tools.label: Query Original Tool History
registered_tools.description: Retrieve original tool call results that have been pruned from active context. Pass the short refs from a pruner-summary message to get back the full original outputs.

registered_tools.name: context_prune
registered_tools.label: Prune Context
registered_tools.description: Summarize and prune preceding tool-call results from context to reduce context size.

system_prompt_injections.description: Appends [Context Prune — Agentic Auto Mode] instructions to system prompt explaining when and how to prune.

storage_paths.in_memory_session_index: Session index stored in memory during active session
storage_paths.redirection_mechanism: Set environment variable PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/home/khoa/pi-context-lab/.pi-agent to redirect settings.json.

network_activity.details: Invokes Pi's configured LLM provider via ctx.model / provider.stream(...) to summarize pruned tool call batches. Does not make unmediated third-party telemetry calls.

pi-context-prune.rationale: Zero external runtime dependencies; ships pre-bundled standalone ESM in dist/index.js. Fully compatible with Node.js 24 and Pi 1.4.0. Registers 2 tools and context manipulation hooks. Makes LLM inference calls via Pi's native model provider interface to generate summaries.

network_activity.details: Pure local deterministic rule-based pruning (deduplication, purge errors, length trimming, message range compression). No external HTTP/network/telemetry calls.

@pi-vault/pi-dcp.rationale: Specifies engines >=24.15.0 which matches Node v24.21.0. Zero runtime dependencies (uses Pi's bundled modules and node core). Entry point is TypeScript loaded via Pi's extension loader. Fully functional, safe, and robust.

storage_paths.project_storage_base: ~/.pi-context-engine/projects/<project-slug>/ (manifest.json, stats.json, graph.db, embedding_cache.db, fts/, vectors/, sessions/)
storage_paths.redirection_mechanism: Configure storage.path in ~/.pi-context-engine/config.yaml or ./.context-engine.yaml to point to /home/khoa/pi-context-lab/storage, and set PCE_TRANSFORMERS_CACHE=/home/khoa/pi-context-lab/models.

network_activity.details: 1) Fetches live Anthropic pricing from https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models with 5s timeout; 2) When embedding backend is 'local', downloads ONNX embedding models (~80MB) via @huggingface/transformers from HuggingFace Hub; 3) When embedding backend is 'ollama', calls http://localhost:11434; 4) Starts local HTTP dashboard server on 127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port> when /context-dashboard command runs.

pi-context-engine.rationale: Candidate is NOT_READY out of the box because dependencies are uninstalled. better-sqlite3 requires native compilation (node-gyp) or compatible prebuilts for Node 24 (ABI 137). sqlite-vec provides prebuilt binaries for linux-x64. web-tree-sitter requires WASM binaries. Additionally, local embeddings require installing @huggingface/transformers and downloading model weights (~80MB), or connecting to an external Ollama instance.
